answer: Proposal: attested-kernel gate. Each answer must be countersigned by a TEE whose measured kernel holds a manufacturer-certified chip key; the registry — a harbor admitting one key per chip — binds one identity per physical enclave, so clones cannot share hardware. An n-clone raid rents n enclaves: linear cost. The reward river is a fixed pool, so n clones draw n shares yet pay n rents each epoch, profiting only if a share tops the rent. Leaks: rented fleets and a colluding issuer still scale; the gate prices identities, it does not prove persons.
